name: 2027 NWT Rock the Rings Festival (U20) Doubles
description:
Teams must pay team fees prior to the registration deadline. All fees must be paid online using a credit card.

Important:

 The undersigned, jointly and separately, hereby agree that all team members:

1. Have met all requirements as set out in the Curling NT Rules and Regulations;

2. Understand and will adhere to the Curling NT Code of Conduct; and

3. Are aware of all age restrictions, residency requirements, and the dates and sites of each of the championship levels.
